categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Karon Eco-Valve Manufacturing Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of water-saving valves. Its main product lines include butterfly valves, gate valves, control valves, check valves, and other supporting products, serving sectors such as urban water supply and drainage, water conservancy projects, firefighting water supply, smart water management, petrochemical and industrial applications, and data center systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including soft and hard sealing valve technologies, valve and pipeline protection, efficient control, and performance simulation testing. It employs a make-to-order production model supplemented by safety stock, with in-house R&D, design, processing, assembly, and testing, while outsourcing simpler components. The company emphasizes intelligent valve technologies, digital valve status monitoring, and remote control systems, integrating renewable energy solutions like wind-solar hybrid power for remote valve management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal water supply and drainage authorities, water conservancy engineering projects, firefighting systems, industrial enterprises requiring water and fluid control, and data center operators. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong presence in major Chinese cities and expanding into emerging sectors like smart water management and data center fluid control.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with sales and service networks across nearly thirty major cities, divided into three core regions: North China, East China, and South China. It also has wholly-owned subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and Hunan province, with overseas trade activities through its Hong Kong subsidiary.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Karon Eco-Valve operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of valves and related control equipment. It sources raw materials and components from suppliers but retains core R&D and production capabilities internally, positioning itself as a key manufacturer and solution provider in the valve industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in water-saving valve technologies, intelligent valve systems, and digital water management solutions. It invests in R&D centers and collaborates with universities and research institutes to develop smart valves, digital twin technologies, and remote monitoring platforms. Strategic focus also includes expanding production capacity, enhancing automation, and developing new products for emerging markets such as data centers and smart water infrastructure.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of valve products and related equipment, including both direct sales to end customers and sales through distributors. The company also earns income from providing integrated solutions, technical services, and after-sales support. A small portion of revenue comes from investment income and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include international valve manufacturers like Emerson and Avice, and domestic companies such as Neway, Jiangsu Shentong, and others in the valve manufacturing sector. Shanghai Karon Eco-Valve is positioned as a leading domestic player in the water-saving valve niche, with strong brand recognition, extensive product variety, and advanced intelligent valve technologies, holding a stable market position in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 914.7 million, a 13.47% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 75.9 million, down 22.98%. Total assets reached RMB 2.7 billion, showing a slight increase. Despite revenue and profit declines, the company maintains solid financial foundations and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D, aiming for steady growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive product range with over 7,000 specifications across 41 valve categories, advanced sealing technologies, and intelligent valve solutions that enable water-saving and energy efficiency. Its products are recognized for reliability, quality, and compliance with national standards, supported by strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and certifications. The integration of smart monitoring and remote control systems differentiates it in the market, catering to evolving customer needs in urban water management and industrial applications.
